meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对渲染出来的界面做视觉质检:先截图取证并跑脚本生成差异数据,再派两个只读审查子代理并行复核,最后按页给出通过或不过的结论。
howto.when: 建完或改完任何 UI 后、问某个页面或组件看起来对不对时触发;终端 TUI 和分页文档同样覆盖。没有渲染界面时跳过。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个页面改完之后渲染得对不对
say.note: 会截图取证并派审查子代理给出结论

say.text: 这个 TUI 有没有溢出或边框错位?
say.note: 用 xterm.js 渲染截图并跑宽度检查

say.text: 把这个 PDF 每一页都截图检查一遍
say.note: 逐页渲染成图片并逐页判定

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs visual QA on rendered UIs: it captures screenshot evidence, runs a script for diff data, dispatches two read-only reviewer subagents in parallel, then gives a per-page pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page or component looks right; also covers terminal TUIs and paginated documents. Skipped when nothing is rendered.

say_en.text: Check whether this page renders correctly after my change
say_en.note: Captures evidence and dispatches reviewers for a verdict

say_en.text: Does this TUI overflow or have misaligned borders?
say_en.note: Renders it via xterm.js and runs the width check

say_en.text: Screenshot and check every page of this PDF
say_en.note: Each page is rendered to an image and judged
